change_summary: Added an efficiency directive instructing the agent to batch multi-item requests into a single confirm-then-execute cycle with one concise summary.
reason_for_change: Transcripts (tasks 23, 54) show the agent doing a separate confirm->tool->summary round-trip per item (helmet, luggage, grill), inflating turns to 23-43/task. Batching confirmations and summaries for multi-part requests reduces round-trips and verbose output, lowering mean turns and cost while preserving the confirm-before-execute step that safeguards success.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.552768 >= threshold 0.549781 (best mean 0.580574 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: The system prompt lets the agent respond after every single user micro-confirmation, inflating turns (23-43/task); instructing it to batch multi-item requests into a single confirm-then-execute cycle will cut turns without dropping success.
